meta.name: Sales CRM
meta.origin: kalita/frameworks — curated by Kalita Forge, reviewed by Architect Pro + Security Pro (product mission A)

vocabulary.meaning: A specific deal with an amount and a stage
Revenue forecast by stage and probability

stages.what: movement through the pipeline; a discount above the threshold — HITL SalesManager
closing the deal; a loss — with a reason

segregation_of_duties.rule: A salesperson does not approve their own discount above the threshold
The forecast is approved by SalesManager, not by the person who assembled it

control_points.what: unique name + agent check on conversion
a discount above the threshold — requires approval(SalesManager)
a deal with no movement for N days — reminder/escalation
a lost deal without a reason cannot be closed

kpis.label: Sum of open deals by stage
Share of leads that became deals

required.question: What do you sell, and what does a deal look like — a one-off sale or a long cycle?
required.why: Determines the entities and pipeline stages

required.question: Who runs sales — your own salespeople, partners, or both?
required.why: Determines the roles and ownership rules

important.question: What stages does a deal go through?
important.why: The pipeline is the heart of CRM; the default is sensible

important.question: Is there a discount threshold above which approval is required?
important.why: Margin control — a typical HITL gate

important.question: Is a revenue forecast needed?
important.why: Changes the dashboards and manager permissions

optional.question: Connect email/calendar?
optional.why: An integration that affects reminders; can be deferred

optional.question: Is lead scoring needed?
optional.why: Changes the agent's qualification work; can be deferred

alternatives.tradeoffs: only leads and their statuses; deal with deals later

anti_patterns.why: a deal without an owner does not move — ownership is mandatory
the forecast must be computed from stages, not from gut feeling

regulatory.note: Storage of customer personal data — PII fields and shredding (existing pii layer)

automations.what: the agent enriches and scores a new lead
a reminder to the owner when a deal goes stale
the next action after each stage

agent_roles.name: SalesAgent
agent_roles.note: qualifies and reminds, does not sell

approvals.what: a discount above the threshold — requires approval(SalesManager)
the forecast report is approved by SalesManager
